entries.name: mcp
entries.reason: reports mcp_requests_total{outcome}, mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome}, mcp_auth_failures_total{reason}, mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}, mcp_key_fetches_total{outcome} and mcp_issuer_up (the IssuerProbe, once a minute), one McpToolCall log line per tool call and an mcp.tool <name> span; a new assistant grant is an audit row and an assistant_grant.created event

entries.name: web-e2e
entries.reason: test project, not deployed

entries.name: keycloak
entries.reason: staging only; health at /realms/master, answering once the realm is imported; the MCP server's mcp_issuer_up probe is the only signal (Keycloak itself sends no telemetry)

entries.name: mcp
entries.reason: staging only; health at /health/live; mcp_issuer_up is its liveness series

entries.name: insights
entries.reason: four nightly jobs, platform-daily, response-stats, profile-views and demand-daily, counted by motorfix_jobs_total{job_name,outcome} and logged once on their final failure; a missed night of the first two leaves the last figures in place and the next night recounts; demand-daily logs the days it wrote, and a missed night is caught up by the next, the read counting an unwritten day live meanwhile; profile-views has its own final-failure alert, since its counters expire two days after their day

entries.name: status-checks
entries.reason: one job every 30 seconds probes the admin dashboard's six service tiles and stores them in status_tile, counted by motorfix_jobs_total{job_name,outcome} and logged once on its final failure; a confirmed tile change logs 'StatusChecks <tile> <state> <figures>' and writes status_tile.changed; a failed run is not retried, the next one follows in 30 seconds; the tiles' own alerting is a later story

entries.name: system-log
entries.reason: the system_log_entry table's purge: one scheduler, system-log-purge, at 03:30 Europe/Bucharest deletes system log entries older than 90 days, counted by motorfix_jobs_total{job_name,outcome}, logging the rows deleted and once on its final failure, which worker-jobs-failed alerts; each new entry also publishes system_log.added to the admin live channel straight to Redis, a failed publish logging one SystemLog warning

entries.name: motorfix_system_log_entries_total
entries.reason: counts every system status log write by kind and outcome (written, grouped, dropped), charted per hour and per day by outcome on motorfix-product, with one SystemLog error line per dropped entry naming only its kind and source; a dropped rate is the database being down, which postgres-unreachable and api-error-rate already alert

entries.name: verification-result
entries.reason: counted by motorfix_verification_result_total (built, skipped) on motorfix-queues; one VerificationResult log line per event with the file id, the decision and the owners told, and one for a sending (ST-301) with the number of admins told (the counter counts decisions only); the job runs in the worker's queue span; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth, and the alert fires on a job's final failure

entries.name: garage-suspended
entries.reason: counted by motorfix_garage_suspended_notices_total (built, skipped) on motorfix-queues; one GarageSuspended log line per event with the garage id, the cause and the owners told, never the reason; the job runs in the worker's queue span; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth, and the shared backlog and failed-job rules alert on it

entries.name: quote-accepted
entries.reason: one QuoteAccepted log line per job naming the quote id and how many staff were told, or why none; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth and failures; the acceptances themselves are counted by motorfix_quote_accepts_total

entries.name: quote-received
entries.reason: counted by motorfix_quote_received_total (built, muted) on motorfix-queues and motorfix-product; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth and failures

entries.name: quote-timers
entries.reason: carries the relay's request.declined events and each decline's undo-window timer and sweep; counted by motorfix_decline_windows_closed_total (sent, muted, skipped_undone, skipped_closed, already_told, by timer or sweep) with one DeclineWindow log line per window naming the recipient id; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth and failures; decline-window-sweep-late fires when the sweep closes more than 10 windows in an hour (lost timers)

entries.name: brevo
entries.reason: carries e-mail and the WhatsApp sign-in and phone-change codes (ST-139: sent straight from the API, a failure logs 'phone code not sent: whatsapp_failed (<kind>)' and counts on the request-duration metric as the sign-in's 502 or the phone change's 503 send_failed, which api-error-rate covers); worker-jobs-failed and worker-saturation cover the worker's e-mail sends

entries.name: s3
entries.reason: the app's object store; the worker's status checks also list the nightly backup bucket with their own client (libs/domain/src/status/probes/probes.ts, BACKUP_S3_*, ST-294), a failed listing showing the backup tile red with its reason

entries.name: geoapify
entries.reason: reports motorfix_places_lookups_total{provider,outcome} and motorfix_places_provider_duration_seconds{provider}

entries.name: public-web
entries.reason: the status checks call the public web address every 30 seconds (/health/ready, the popular brands and one garage search without the log flag), timed on the Outside calls row (http_client_request_duration_seconds by server_address); a failed probe shows its tile red, the tiles' own alerting is a later story

entries.name: openfreemap
entries.reason: map tiles fetched by the browser, no key; a failed load shows the map-down message and is not counted server-side

entries.name: onrc-portal
entries.reason: a link the admin opens in a new tab to look a company up by hand; neither the browser app nor the API calls it, and the check the admin records is counted by motorfix_verification_checks_total

entries.name: anaf-company-lookup
entries.reason: a link the admin opens in a new tab to look a CUI up by hand; neither the browser app nor the API calls it, and the check the admin records is counted by motorfix_verification_checks_total

entries.name: motorfix_maintenance_refusals_total
entries.reason: counts calls refused while maintenance is on, by route and role (visitor or signed_in); ST-879 adds the dashboard; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_platform_rule_changes_total
entries.reason: counts rule change requests by action (requested, approved, refused, cancelled), with one PlatformRuleChanges log line per step; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: grafana-faro
entries.reason: the browser's collector; besides the web vitals and errors it receives the prefetch measurement (context path profile, outcome fetched, cancelled, hit, expired or skipped, and a fetch's duration), shown on the web-vitals dashboard's pre-fetch panel

entries.name: keycloak
entries.reason: the identity server signing-key fetch, host read from ASSISTANT_ISSUER; counted in mcp_key_fetches_total{outcome} on the mcp dashboard; a failed fetch fires mcp-key-fetch-failures, and calls answer 503 (not counted as sign-in failures); the IssuerProbe reads its discovery document once a minute into mcp_issuer_up, which fires mcp-issuer-unreachable

entries.name: plausible
entries.reason: only the visitor's browser calls it, and only after a valid Accept; nothing on the server waits on it, Plausible's own site shows the page views, and the consent choices it rests on are counted on motorfix-product (motorfix_consent_records_total)

entries.name: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"list_quote_requests|get_schedule|get_day_sheet|get_stats|decline_quote_request"}
entries.reason: the four garage read tools count under mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome} and mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}, one McpToolCall log line and an mcp.tool <name> span per call, like every tool; the existing mcp-tool-errors alert sums every tool; reads write no audit row; decline_quote_request (ST-345) acts, so its decline writes the audit row marked via the assistant and counts in motorfix_request_declines_total

entries.name: motorfix_cache_total
entries.reason: counts each cached read (profile, home, popular-brands, brands (whether a brand slug a profile read names is in the catalogue), and the pre-fetched driver-home and garage-home lists) by outcome: hit, miss, stale (served past its soft expiry), coalesced (a concurrent read served by another read's call), negative (a remembered not-found or empty answer), fallback (Redis failed and PostgreSQL answered), warm (filled by the post-deploy warm-up or, for driver-home and garage-home, by a sign-in), and purge (an entry removed by a tag purge, from the worker); one warn log line when Redis first fails and one when it is back; a fallback rate above 5% for 10 minutes is the api-cache-fallback-rate alert, and a driver-home or garage-home hit rate (hits / warms) under 30% for 60 minutes over at least 50 warms is the api-prefetch-hit-rate alert

entries.name: motorfix_cache_warm_read_seconds
entries.reason: times each read a warm fills, by kind: a sign-in warm (driver-home, garage-home), the wait a hit on that entry saves, shown as its p75 on the pre-fetch panel, and the post-deploy warm-up (profile, home, popular-brands), which no panel shows

entries.name: motorfix_quote_requests_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quote requests sent by outcome (sent with its recipients, cannot_receive, limit, invalid — invalid counts the use case's own refusals, not the validation pipe's or a missing Idempotency-Key), with one log line per send naming the outcome and the request id; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_request_received_total
entries.reason: counts each garage a new request reaches by outcome (built, muted, skipped), with one log line per event naming the request id and how many staff it reached; a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quotes_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quotes garages send by outcome (sent, refused, already_answered, request_not_open; refused covers the service's own 400, 403 and 404, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) and records motorfix_quote_response_minutes (request created to quote sent) with no identifiers, with one Quotes log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quote_accepts_total
entries.reason: counts the acceptances drivers try by outcome (accepted, replayed, booking_pending, slot_passed, invalid_transition, refused; refused covers the service's 404 and the controller's Idempotency-Key 400, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) with no identifiers, with one QuoteAccept log line per try naming the quote id, the booking id and the outcome; a drop in acceptances is a product signal, not an outage; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_request_declines_total
entries.reason: counts garage declines by outcome (declined, already_answered, request_not_open, invalid; invalid counts the service's own 403 and 404, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) and reason code, with no identifiers, and one Declines log line per decline naming the recipient and request ids; the route is POST /api/v1/garage/requests/{id}/decline in http.server.request.duration; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_decline_windows_closed_total
entries.reason: counts each closed decline undo window by outcome and whether the timer or the sweep closed it; a rising sweep share means lost timers; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_verification_result_total
entries.reason: it cannot fire on staging while no admin decision endpoint exists: only the automatic approval reaches it, and that holds only under APP_ENV=test; counts each verification decision told to its garage's owners by outcome (built, skipped: no owner or no decision to tell), with the fan-out's log line naming the file id; also on motorfix-product; a count has no failure to alert on, the verification-result queue entry owns the final-failure alert

entries.name: motorfix_garage_suspended_notices_total
entries.reason: counts each suspension told to its garage's owners by outcome (built, skipped: no owner or no open suspension), with the fan-out's log line naming the garage id; a count has no failure to alert on, the garage-suspended queue entry owns the failed-job alert

entries.name: motorfix_garage_suspensions_total
entries.reason: counts each garage suspension by cause (recheck_failed, documents_overdue, admin, report_confirmed); the audit holds who and why; a count has no failure to alert on, the admin-garage-suspension endpoint entry owns the error and latency alerts

entries.name: motorfix_quote_received_total
entries.reason: counts each sent quote announced to its driver by outcome (built, muted), with the fan-out's log line naming the quote id; also on motorfix-product; a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: admin-garage-suspension
entries.reason: each suspension and each refused one is audited with the admin, the cause and the reason; the count by cause is the motorfix_garage_suspensions_total entry

entries.name: quote-requests-compare
entries.reason: the driver's comparison of one request's quotes, read from PostgreSQL and writing quote.first_seen_at once; no counter or alert of its own: a read of the driver's own data, covered by the API's error-rate and latency alerts; no outside call

entries.name: quotes
entries.reason: one log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; the send counter and response-time histogram are the motorfix_quotes_sent_total entry

entries.name: quote-accept
entries.reason: one log line per acceptance naming the quote id, the booking id and the outcome; the count by outcome is the motorfix_quote_accepts_total entry

entries.name: motorfix_searches_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_search_cache_total
entries.reason: counts each garage search page read by cache outcome (hit, miss, fallback when Redis failed and PostgreSQL answered), with one warn log line when Redis first fails and one when it is back; a fallback rate above 5% for 10 minutes is the api-search-cache-fallback-rate alert

entries.name: motorfix_search_log_total
entries.reason: counts each search log row written or lost, with one warn log line naming the error when a write fails; the search still answers; a failure rate above 5% for 10 minutes is the api-search-log-failure-rate alert

entries.name: motorfix_search_pins_total
entries.reason: counts each pins answer by outcome (results, none) and mode (area, bbox) for the map on Results; a count has no failure to alert on: the route's errors and latency are the api-error-rate and api-latency rules, and its Redis fallback is in motorfix_search_cache_total under the api-search-cache-fallback-rate alert

entries.name: motorfix_sign_ins_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_garage_sign_ups_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_garage_approvals_total
entries.reason: it cannot fire on staging while no admin decision endpoint exists: only the automatic approval reaches it, and that holds only under APP_ENV=test; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quotes_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_emails_sent_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_notifications_sent_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: garage-job-steps
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'job step refused' line with ids and its code

entries.name: motorfix_job_steps_total
entries.reason: counts step changes by action (added, renamed, reordered, removed, ticked, unticked); a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_account_changes_total
entries.reason: counts saved changes of an account's own details by field (name, city, email, phone, password); a change count has no failure mode of its own

entries.name: my-details
entries.metric: http.server.request.duration by http.route PATCH /api/v1/me, POST /api/v1/me/email, /api/v1/me/phone, /api/v1/me/phone/confirm and /api/v1/auth/confirm-email (the change link)
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'phone change refused: <code>' or 'e-mail change link not sent' line, never the address or number; the WhatsApp code goes out through the brevo entry and a failed send logs 'phone code not sent: whatsapp_failed (<kind>)' and answers 503 send_failed; saved changes are motorfix_account_changes_total; spans come from the HTTP and Prisma auto-instrumentation

entries.name: auth-password
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'password change refused: <code>' line and a failed notice e-mail logs 'password changed e-mail not sent'; a saved change counts on motorfix_account_changes_total{field="password"}

entries.name: garage-reports
entries.reason: refusals show on the request-duration metric by route and status code

entries.name: saved-garages
entries.reason: PUT, DELETE, GET ids and the GET list (ST-291) show on the request-duration metric by route and status code; each save and removal is an audit row and a saved_garage.added or saved_garage.removed event, and reading the list changes nothing, so no product counter is added; the list's spans come from the HTTP and Prisma auto-instrumentation

entries.name: motorfix_garage_reports_total
entries.reason: outcomes created, already_reported and refused (both 409); 404 and 429 read from the request-duration metric by route and status; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: listing-documents
entries.reason: a page left in storage after a failed delete logs one warning with the draft id and key

entries.name: listing-draft-check
entries.metric: http.server.request.duration by http.route /api/v1/listing-drafts/:id/check and status (200 sendable, 422 listing_incomplete, 404, 409)
entries.reason: read-only and writes nothing; a 422 is the owner's form still lacking values, not a failure, so it is read by status on the dashboard and not alerted on; the api traces carry the route span

entries.name: admin-verification-documents
entries.reason: each issued address writes one open entry in the history and counts motorfix_documents_opened_total

entries.name: admin-verification-file-read
entries.reason: a read with no writes; the API-wide error and latency rules cover it, so it has no alert of its own

entries.name: admin-verification-file-open
entries.reason: the first opening logs one line (file, admin) and emits verification.opened; the API-wide error and latency rules cover it, so it has no alert of its own

entries.name: admin-verification-check-record
entries.reason: each save logs one VerificationChecks line (file, kind, result, admin; never the detail or the company name), writes an audit entry and emits verification.check_recorded, and is counted by motorfix_verification_checks_total; the API-wide error and latency rules cover it, so it has no alert of its own

entries.name: motorfix_verification_checks_total
entries.reason: counts each check an admin records on a garage's file by kind and result; a refused save is not counted; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_documents_uploaded_total
entries.reason: counts each confirmed document page by kind (onrc_certificate, rar_authorisation); a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_declarations_signed_total
entries.reason: counts each signed declaration; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_documents_opened_total
entries.reason: it cannot fire on staging while no web screen calls the document download address; counts each time an admin opens a document page, by kind; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: admin-demand
entries.reason: the admin's demand read, counts only; a failed read answers the standard error body and is the api-error-rate rule's

entries.name: admin-system-log
entries.reason: the admin's read of today's log entries, twenty at most on an indexed time range; a failed read answers the standard error body and is the api-error-rate rule's

entries.name: profile-views
entries.reason: the public profile's beacon; every outcome is the motorfix_profile_views_total entry, which owns the lost-view alert

entries.name: motorfix_profile_views_total
entries.reason: counts each beacon by outcome (accepted, bot, staff, no_key, lost, throttled, not_found) with no garage, address or visitor label; a lost view logs one ProfileViews error line naming the Redis error only

entries.name: motorfix_profile_view_rows_total
entries.reason: counts the daily rows the night writes and the days it logs as gaps, with one ProfileViews log line per day naming the day and the count; a failed night is the profile-views-job-failed alert

entries.name: motorfix_consent_records_total
entries.reason: counts each analytics consent choice stored, by decision; a choice count has no failure mode of its own; the consents endpoint carries the api error-rate and latency rules

entries.name: outage-alerts
entries.reason: Grafana's outage contact point calls it; one Outage log line per alert (service, state, fingerprint, admins, sent), never the token or an address; the uptime checks (infra/observability/uptime/checks.json) and the outage rule watch the services it reports on

entries.name: search-garages
entries.reason: answers from the 60 s Redis cache or PostgreSQL; the cache and log outcomes are the motorfix_search_cache_total and motorfix_search_log_total entries, and new searches still count in motorfix_searches_total

entries.name: search-garages-pins
entries.reason: every pin of a search for the map on Results, from the 60 s Redis cache or PostgreSQL; its answers count in motorfix_search_pins_total by outcome and mode, and a Redis fallback in motorfix_search_cache_total under the api-search-cache-fallback-rate alert; no outside call (the browser fetches the tiles from the place-step map's provider)

entries.name: bunny
entries.reason: the CDN's API, which the worker's CdnPurgeSender calls to purge a garage page (garage:<id>) or the search pages (search) by tag after a cache event; counted by motorfix_cdn_purges_total{outcome=sent|failed}, a failure logs 'cdn purge failed <tag> <status|error>' and the tag goes back on the queue; worker-cdn-purge-failed fires on purges that keep failing for 15 minutes; worker-saturation covers the sender's host, and worker-jobs-failed the relay jobs whose purges it carries. scripts/cdn.ts (release.yml's purge step and the config check) calls the same API from CI, outside the inventory's reach

entries.name: motorfix_cdn_purges_total
entries.reason: counts each tag purge the worker sends to the CDN by outcome (sent, failed); a failed one is queued again and logs one warn line naming the tag and the status

entries.name: motorfix_origin_refused_total
entries.reason: counts each request the web origin refused with 403 because X-Origin-Secret was missing or wrong (someone reaching Railway's address past the CDN), with one warn log line per refusal; no alert: refusals are the lock-down working, and a CDN that stopped sending the secret shows as the web-down and error-rate alerts at the edge

entries.name: support-messages
entries.reason: carries one job per stored contact message (the support e-mail with a reply-to, then the acknowledgement); counted by motorfix_support_emails_total with one Support log line per e-mail naming the reference; the unsent gauge motorfix_support_messages_unsent, read every 60 s, raises support-message-unsent after an hour above 0 (SUPPORT_EMAIL unset or sending failing)

entries.name: motorfix_support_messages_total
entries.reason: counts contact-form sends by outcome (stored, refused_limit, trap, invalid) with no identifiers and one Support log line per stored message naming its reference; a maintenance refusal counts in motorfix_maintenance_refusals_total; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_support_emails_total
entries.reason: counts the support and acknowledgement e-mails by kind and outcome (sent, blocked, failed, unconfigured); a message left unsent is caught by the gauge's support-message-unsent alert, not by this count

entries.name: motorfix_support_messages_unsent
entries.reason: a gauge of stored messages whose support e-mail is pending or waiting for SUPPORT_EMAIL, read from PostgreSQL every 60 s; above 0 for an hour fires support-message-unsent
